rules.text: Products purchased from clinique.com must be returned in new or gently used condition and within 30 days from the date the order is delivered.
rules.quote: Products purchased from clinique.com must be returned in new or gently used condition and within 30 days from the date the order is delivered.

rules.text: A non-refundable $7 shipping charge will be deducted from your refund.
rules.quote: A non-refundable $7 shipping charge will be deducted from your refund.

rules.text: All shipping, delivery, and return fees are non-refundable.
rules.quote: All shipping, delivery, and return fees are non-refundable. This includes state-imposed shipping fees.

rules.text: Clinique eGift Cards cannot be exchanged or returned to Clinique Online.
rules.quote: Clinique eGift Cards are issued by ELC Brands Management Inc. and sold by its third-party partner, CashStar, and thus cannot be exchanged or returned to Clinique Online.

rules.text: Returns must comply with the return policy and are inspected upon receipt at the warehouse.
rules.quote: We accept returns for products purchased from clinique.com only, and all returns are inspected upon receipt at our warehouse.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds that returns must comply with the return policy, which is not stated in the quote. The quote only mentions inspection upon receipt.

rules.text: The purchase price will be refunded to the original form of payment for items returned within the return policy.
rules.quote: For items returned within our returns policy, the purchase price will be refunded to the original form of payment.

rules.text: Refunds will be processed within 3 business days of receipt at the warehouse.
rules.quote: Returns will be processed within 3 business days of receipt at our warehouse, and you will receive a credit confirmation with your refund amount once your return has been fully processed.

rules.text: Refunds to credit cards, Clinique gift cards, Alipay, or Instagram orders can take 7-10 business days to post.
rules.quote: Refunds issued to a credit card, Clinique gift card, Alipay, or for orders placed through Instagram can take up to 7-10 business days to post to your account.

rules.text: Refunds for returns received after 30 days are not guaranteed and are at Clinique Online's discretion.
rules.quote: Refunds for returns received after 30 days are not guaranteed and will be made at the sole discretion of Clinique Online.

rules.text: To exchange a product, return the unwanted product and place a new order for the desired product.
rules.quote: If you would like to exchange a product(s), simply return the eligible unwanted product(s). A refund will be processed within 3 business days of receipt. You may place a new order for the product(s) you wish to purchase at any time.
